F_scope: The registered whole-T standardized Oil_temperature mean matches an independent calculation. This validates arithmetic only; the richer correlation interpretation has no independent full-data replication.
P_scope: Exploration B0 is 6.778628% worse in NMSE than persistence in the preregistered high_input_variation scope for TP2, H1, DV_eletric.
L_scope: Three-seed local NMSE gain versus B0 is 3.524254%, above the registered 3% threshold. This does not establish the sign mechanism.
C_scope: The matched all-positive historical source-half control has lower overall and local NMSE in each confirmation seed. The candidate is 0.384154% worse overall and 13.109430% worse locally, using ratios of seed-mean NMSE.
E_scope: All three confirmation seeds improve NMSE versus B0; mean NMSE improves 3.940884%, mean NMAE improves 0.361558% under the frozen development checkpoint policy.
U_scope: Exploration update is receipt-linked, numerically correct and explicitly limits support to one seed versus B0 while reserving mechanism and generalization for later evidence. No confirmation feedback was returned to the search agent.
recommendation: Retain known all-positive source-half as the stronger NMSE reference in this comparison; do not promote the new sign rule. Keep the agent's frozen selected policy unchanged as historical evidence.
limitations: One autonomous search context, one generated processing candidate, reused same-source D, three additional random seeds; no independent dataset or untouched test.
D selects the best checkpoint every 500 steps and also supports development comparisons; selection optimism is not removed by seed repetition.
Control matches mapping, coefficients in absolute magnitude, windows, sampling and training, but sign alters input magnitude and covariance; informational and optimization effects are not isolated.
Registered local scope includes H1, whose sign is unchanged; preserve that scope rather than retrospectively narrowing it.
The sign rule has slightly lower NMAE than the control but worse NMSE; do not claim dominance on every metric.
One confirmation control was retried under a declared monitor repair with identical scientific identity; failed execution and cost retained.
